messages:
sara: Morning! Quick ask — we have onboarding Monday at the SF office and want to order breakfast for ~20 people. Looking for a nearby bakery that does mixed trays (pastries + some vegan and gluten-free options). Budget around $100. Any recs or volunteers to pickup? :croissant:
liam: Ooh yes. Mission Toast is solid and does GF muffins on request. Pickup is ~5–10m from the office.
priya: +1 for Mission Toast. They do mini savory turnovers too. Also, Sunrise Bakeshop on 3rd has a vegan box option.
davide: Sunrise Bakeshop is great and they'll label items. Pricing might be tight for $100 for 20 though — maybe do a mix: pastry box from Sunrise + a couple of fruit platters from Safeway?
sara: Good idea. Anyone want to take the pickup/run? I can do ordering if someone can grab around 8:30am.
liam: I can pick up if you order by Friday noon. I’ll be in the office Monday earlier.
priya: Heads up — we have one person with a nut allergy in the group. Can we ask vendors to label and avoid cross-contact?
davide: I’ll DM the new hire to confirm dietary constraints.
ann-bot: Reminder: Please fill the onboarding dietary form: https://redwood.example.com/onboard-food — we need final counts by Friday 3pm.
sara: Thanks — plan: order Sunrise vegan box (8 items), Mission Toast mixed pastry tray (12 items), and a small fruit platter. Target budget $110 if needed. Liam will pick up at 8:30am.
liam: Confirmed. If Sunrise can do GF labelling that’s ideal. I’ll text vendors to confirm.
priya: Can we also add a couple of almond/soy milk jugs for coffee? Some folks prefer non-dairy.
sara: Yep already on the order list.
davide: Suggestion: put a little sign near the food table with symbols: V = vegan, GF, N for nuts. Saves folks asking.
liam: Will bring markers and a printed legend.
sara: Thanks team! I’ll place orders after collecting final counts. If anyone wants to chip in for extra croissants, drop $ in the team pool. :euro:
priya: I’ll toss $10 in.
liam: same.
ann-bot: Order deadline reminder set for Friday 15:00.
